objective: COA Gate 6E. Ejecutar preflight READ_ONLY_SQL previo a cualquier seed fisico de dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus. Validar estructura exacta de la tabla y su PK/unicidad, filas existentes, colisiones por IDs 1..6, colisiones por codigos BORRADOR/PENDIENTE_TIMBRADO/TIMBRADO/ERROR_TIMBRADO/CANCELACION_SOLICITADA/CANCELADO, referencias existentes desde dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos, y que no exista evidencia de uso productivo de esos IDs/codigos. No DDL, no DML, no EXEC, no seeds, no workflow, no Produccion. El resultado debe permitir decidir si Gate 6D es seguro para ejecucion controlada en Development.

queries.name: gate6e_database_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: gate6e_target_table_structure
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: gate6e_target_keys_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.has_filter,STRING_AGG(c.name,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal) AS key_columns FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id AND ic.is_included_column=0 JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus') AND i.index_id>0 GROUP BY i.name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.has_filter ORDER BY i.is_primary_key DESC,i.name

queries.name: gate6e_existing_rows
queries.sql: SELECT EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID,Codigo,Nombre,Descripcion,EsFinal,Activo FROM dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus ORDER BY EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID

queries.name: gate6e_id_collisions
queries.sql: SELECT EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID,Codigo,Nombre,Descripcion,EsFinal,Activo FROM dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus WHERE EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID IN (1,2,3,4,5,6) ORDER BY EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID

queries.name: gate6e_code_collisions
queries.sql: SELECT EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID,Codigo,Nombre,Descripcion,EsFinal,Activo FROM dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus WHERE Codigo IN ('BORRADOR','PENDIENTE_TIMBRADO','TIMBRADO','ERROR_TIMBRADO','CANCELACION_SOLICITADA','CANCELADO') ORDER BY Codigo

queries.name: gate6e_references_to_seed_ids
queries.sql: SELECT EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS referenced_rows FROM dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos WHERE EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID IN (1,2,3,4,5,6) GROUP BY EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID ORDER BY EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID

queries.name: gate6e_total_emitted_documents
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows FROM dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos

queries.name: gate6e_fk_integrity
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos') AND fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus')
